title: Output of a halted body call
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For any halted configuration $c$ of $B$ on $x$, any Boolean word $w$, any configuration $u$ of $F$ on $x$, and either choice of mode, there is a time $t \le 2|o|+3$, where $o$ is the output word of $c$, at which the loop host started from the call on $c$ halts; its output is $o$ in find mode and the one-bit word $[\mathrm{true}]$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ and $F$ are finite Boolean Turing machines
The mode is either find mode or decision mode
replaced:
Let $c$ be a halted body configuration, $w$ a counter word, and $f$ a fuel
configuration. Then there is a time $t \le 2\,|o| + 3$, where $o$ is the output of $c$,
such that from the stopped call on $c$ with stop flag $\mathrm{true}$ the loop host at
time $t$ has halted with output $o$ in find mode and output the single bit
$\mathrm{true}$ in decision mode.
